findings.description: Imports LineChart, AreaChart, and BarChart from '@/components/admin/charts/' but the directory doesn't exist. This will cause module resolution errors at runtime when navigating to /admin/dashboard. Create the chart components or remove the chart rendering code.

Imports AddStudentModal from '@/components/admin/modals/AddStudentModal' but the component doesn't exist. Clicking the 'Add Student' button will fail at runtime. Create the modal component or disable the button.

Imports AddInstructorModal from '@/components/admin/modals/AddInstructorModal' but the component doesn't exist. Clicking the 'Add Instructor' button will fail at runtime. Create the modal component or disable the button.

Imports CreateClassModal from '@/components/admin/modals/CreateClassModal' but the component doesn't exist. Clicking the 'Schedule Class' button will fail at runtime. Create the modal component or disable the button.

Status badges use hardcoded hex colors (#DCFCE7, #FEF3C7, #FEE2E2 for backgrounds; #16A34A, #D97706, #DC2626 for text) instead of CSS variables. These don't respond to dark mode, breaking the theme system. Add CSS variables for success/warning/error states or map to existing variables like --navy-50, --gold-50.

Class status and type badges use hardcoded hex colors (#FEF3C7, #DCFCE7, #DBEAFE, #FEE2E2 for backgrounds; #D97706, #16A34A, #2563EB, #DC2626 for text). Replace with CSS variables for dark mode compatibility.
Status badges use hardcoded hex colors (#DCFCE7, #FEE2E2, #16A34A, #DC2626). Replace with CSS variables.
Event type badges use hardcoded colors: { backgroundColor: '#FEE2E2', color: '#DC2626' } for exams. Replace with CSS variables.
Notification icon backgrounds use hardcoded colors (#DCFCE7, #16A34A, #DBEAFE, #2563EB, #FEF3C7, #D97706). Replace with semantic CSS variables.
Logout button hover state uses hardcoded background color #FEE2E2. Add a CSS variable for error-hover or error-surface.
Implements custom table with 200+ lines instead of using the reusable DataTable component. Duplicates search, pagination, and mobile layout logic. Refactor to use DataTable.
Implements custom table instead of using DataTable component. Refactor to use DataTable.
Implements custom card grid instead of using DataTable component. Consider refactoring to use DataTable for consistency.
